# gdrivescope

> A Bun-native TypeScript CLI for Google Drive. Index a Drive folder into a local SQLite graph, summarize and embed documents via pluggable LLM + embedding providers, and run semantic search over the result. AI-first: primary consumer is agents via `--json`.

## Installation

Pre-compiled binaries for six platforms ship via [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/SoftwareStartups/gdrivescope/releases). From source: `bun install && task compile`.

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `gdrivescope login` | OAuth loopback + PKCE flow, store refresh token in OS keychain |
| `gdrivescope logout` | Clear stored credentials |
| `gdrivescope index [--scope ID] [--metadata-only] [--resume] [--prune]` | Traverse + extract + summarize + embed |
| `gdrivescope config show` | Print workspace config |
| `gdrivescope config list-roots` | List configured root folders |
| `gdrivescope config add-root <ID>` | Persist a root folder |
| `gdrivescope config remove-root <ID>` | Remove a root folder |
| `gdrivescope list [FOLDER_ID] [-r] [--type folder\|file\|shortcut\|other]` | Tree listing from the local graph |
| `gdrivescope show <ID>` | Node details (path, metadata, summary, topics) |
| `gdrivescope search <QUERY> [--limit N] [--threshold N] [--type ...]` | Semantic + filter search via sqlite-vec |
| `gdrivescope download <ID> [-o PATH]` | Download raw Drive file to disk |

## Index flags

- `--scope <ID>` — start folder (default: configured root)
- `--metadata-only` — skip extraction + LLM + embeddings (free, fast, safe)
- `--resume` — only process files without a summary or with errors
- `--prune` — delete rows for files no longer visible in Drive
- `--concurrency-drive <N>` — max parallel Drive API calls (default 15)
- `--concurrency-llm <N>` — max parallel LLM/embedding calls (default 4)
- `--provider <NAME>` — anthropic | openai | ollama
- `--embedding-provider <NAME>` — openai | voyage | ollama
- `--rebuild-embeddings` — drop + recreate vector table

## Global options

- `--json` — emit `{ok, data}` / `{ok, error, code}` envelope
- `--version`, `-v`
- `--help`, `-h`

## JSON envelope

```json
{"ok": true, "data": {"visited": 42, "summarized": 38, "embedded": 38}}
{"ok": false, "error": "auth required", "code": "AUTH_REQUIRED"}
```

## Classification taxonomy

Documents are classified as: `pitch_deck`, `board_minutes`, `board_presentation`, `financial`, `reporting`, `newsletter`, `legal`, `strategy`, `hr`, `research`, `other`.

## Environment variables

- `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID`, `GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` — Drive API credentials
- `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `VOYAGE_API_KEY` — provider API keys
- `GDRIVESCOPE_LLM_PROVIDER` — `anthropic` | `openai` | `ollama`
- `GDRIVESCOPE_EMBEDDING_PROVIDER` — `openai` | `voyage` | `ollama`
- `GDRIVESCOPE_OLLAMA_HOST`, `GDRIVESCOPE_OLLAMA_MODEL`, `GDRIVESCOPE_OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_MODEL`, `GDRIVESCOPE_OLLAMA_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS`

## Example

```bash
gdrivescope index --scope 1ABC --json
# {"ok":true,"data":{"rootId":"1ABC","visited":42,"folders":5,"files":37,"extracted":35,"summarized":35,"embedded":35,"skipped":2,"errors":0,"pruned":0}}

gdrivescope search "quarterly revenue" --json
# {"ok":true,"data":{"hits":[{"id":"xyz","name":"Q1 Report.pdf","score":0.87,"summary":"..."}]}}
```
